python.rule: normalization/channel golden vectors and repository tests must pass on both supported interpreter lines

identifiers.rule: opaque relational identity only; business identifiers remain separate validated attributes

unicode_matching.casefold_asset: generated full CaseFolding mapping pinned to Unicode 17.0.0
unicode_matching.whitespace_asset: generated Unicode White_Space set pinned to Unicode 17.0.0
unicode_matching.reason: supported Python 3.13/3.14 runtimes must produce byte-identical candidate keys independent of their built-in Unicode database version
unicode_matching.supply_chain: dependency is pinned/hashed in governed dependency metadata; generated Unicode assets retain Unicode source version/checksum provenance and deterministic regeneration tests
unicode_matching.license_handoff: LLD-12 packaging includes applicable Apache-2.0 third-party notice/attribution

email_channel.rule: syntax-only exact one-addr-spec validation; Contact may exist without any channel and recipient-dependent workflows revalidate selected active channels just in time

rules: LLD-02 repositories use LLD-01 UnitOfWork/connection policy

performance.archive_guards: indexed bounded existence checks under write transaction; detailed blocker enumeration outside writer lock

dependency_policy: LLD-02 adds only the pinned Unicode normalization dependency required for cross-Python deterministic matching; all other behavior uses Python standard library or LLD-01 owned facilities.
